strategy_roster.name: VR-ZVER v2
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(ema(close,9),ema(close,21)) and ema(close,21) > ema(close,50) and rsi(close,14) < 30
strategy_roster.notes: EMA 9/21/50 and RSI(14) below 30 are explicit fallbacks because numeric defaults are absent; stochastic is omitted. Pip stops, targets, break-even, trailing, sizing, and time-frame settings are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Phase Cross Strategy with Zone
strategy_roster.notes: The documented length 20 and absolute offset 0.5 are applied directly to the SMA and EMA. The inverse crossover closes the long, and no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: Stairs
strategy_roster.notes: A 20-bar trend line is an explicit proxy for the pending symmetric grid, since order state, price-step conversion, basket PnL, and liquidation are unavailable. ChannelSteps and profit thresholds remain in unsupported point or portfolio units.

strategy_roster.name: AK47 A1
strategy_roster.entry_long: low <= donchian_low_prev(low,2) and ema((high + low) / 2,5) > ema((high + low) / 2,8) and ema((high + low) / 2,8) > ema((high + low) / 2,13) and rsi(close,13) >= 50
strategy_roster.exit_long: ema((high + low) / 2,5) < ema((high + low) / 2,8) or close < ema((high + low) / 2,13)
strategy_roster.notes: Unshifted median-price EMA 13/8/5 replaces the Alligator, a two-bar fresh low replaces its fractal, and RSI(13) replaces DeMarker. Williams %R, point gaps, trailing, and the disabled/source stop are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Moving Average Position System
strategy_roster.notes: SMA(240) retains the documented default lookback and close crossings, with the inverse cross as exit. Optional MA type/shift, martingale sizing, and point-based protection cannot be represented.

strategy_roster.name: MultiBreakout V001k
strategy_roster.notes: A prior 20-bar high approximates the completed reference session and stacked stop entries. Session clocks, staged partial targets, break-even, and moving trailing logic are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Locker Hedging Grid
strategy_roster.notes: SMA(20) is an explicit cycle proxy for the initial long and subsequent flattening. The alternating rescue grid, floating-profit threshold, volumes, and price-step spacing require portfolio and order state.

strategy_roster.name: PPO Cloud
strategy_roster.notes: PPO is expressed exactly as fast-minus-slow EMA divided by slow EMA, with its EMA(9) signal. The documented 12/26/9 crossovers are retained and no stops are specified.

strategy_roster.name: Ten Points 3 v005
strategy_roster.notes: Five-bar MACD slope uses standard 12/26 settings as a fallback because the parameter table has no lengths. Martingale baskets, adverse-distance adds, equity locks, clocks, and pip protection are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: Larry Conners Vix Reversal II
strategy_roster.notes: Local close RSI(25) substitutes for the unavailable VIX series and retains the documented 61 trigger. An RSI(50) recross is the exit proxy; the 7-to-12-day holding timer is unsupported.
